findings.finding: On 2026-10-07 DARPA promoted Atom Computing, Diraq, IBM and IonQ (up to $300m for IonQ) to QBI Stage C. Xanadu was not among them. On 2026-10-19 it got provisional approval for only a one-year Stage B extension worth up to $10m. Stage B was the main source of Q1 and Q2 revenue, so the call will be asked when and whether Stage C comes, and the extension sets revenue at roughly $2.5m a quarter for the next 12 months.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell 7.89% on the 2026-10-19 extension announcement (baseline move for that 6-K). There was no prior print on DARPA staging.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock sold off 7.9% the day of the extension and is down sharply since. What is not priced is management's answer on the Stage C timeline and how the extension is recognised as revenue. If that were known, the Q3/Q4 revenue estimates would agree rather than spanning $2.0m-$2.8m.
findings.independence: DARPA's own Stage C announcement, which does not name Xanadu: https://www.darpa.mil/news/2026/four-more-teams-enter-quantum-benchmarking-initiative-final-stage (2026-10-07).

findings.finding: The revenue bar is disputed and the high end needs Q3 revenue to nearly double from Q2's $1.51m to about $2.8m (Earnings Whispers). Other sources put it at $2.37m or $2.0m. Revenue is almost entirely DARPA Stage B, which was described as completed and then extended, and the company gave no revenue guidance. The last two confirmed prints fell on revenue misses.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (release 2026-08-05: revenue $1.51m, down from Q1's $2.83m; coverage headlined a revenue miss): next-session move -9.26%. Q1 2026 (2026-05-14): -10.11%. FY2025 (2026-04-09, revenue quadrupled): +17.12%. Moves from the baseline for those three confirmed results 6-Ks.
findings.why_not_priced: The bar itself is the uncertainty: if the market held one number, the three estimate sources would agree. A Stage B milestone recognised in Q3 could land above $2.8m, so this is capped small for the disputed bar and lumpiness.
findings.independence: Q2 revenue and its DARPA dependence come from the company's own 6-K: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0002097163/000209716326000020/exhibit991pressrelease-aug.htm (2026-08-05). ChartMill's lower $2.365m bar: https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/XNDU/estimates.

findings.finding: In Q2 a $10.6m loss on earn-out share liabilities was a large part of the $42.1m GAAP net loss. The stock then fell from an average Q2 ATM sale price of $12.28 to about $4.6-4.8 at Q3 end, so the earn-out (and any derivative) liabilities should be remeasured at a Q3 gain. That could make GAAP EPS look far better than the -$0.09 to -$0.19 consensus, but it is non-cash and below operating income.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2's earn-out loss widened the GAAP loss and the stock fell 9.26%, but that reaction was attributed to the revenue miss, not the remeasurement.
findings.why_not_priced: The EPS consensus (-$0.09 to -$0.19) looks like an operating-loss run-rate. If the remeasurement gain were in it, estimates would sit near break-even. Headline algorithms may read a GAAP 'beat'. This is an inference from a remeasurement model with no stated path to guidance, so it is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: Q3-end price levels: about $4.58-4.77 on Sep 30 (search snippets of Yahoo, equibles) and $7.42 on Sep 18 before the lock-up. No separate document confirms the earn-out terms (not found).

findings.finding: Financing: Q2 ended with $312.8m cash after raising $67.2m from Yorkville's synthetic ATM at $12.28. The company counts $686m of total available capital, including the CAD $195m (US$140.2m) federal grant signed 2026-08-28 and $232.8m of ATM capacity. R&D and capex were guided to accelerate in H2 (Q2 adj. EBITDA -$21.3m, capex $6.4m). The Q3 release will show how much of the ATM was used at $3-9 and the cash burn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 showed a larger cash pile from ATM sales and the stock still fell 9.26%, so the cash build was not rewarded.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q3 ATM usage and cash balance are unknown until the release. Asked what the money buys: the Inception facility (CAD $195m grant, 158k sq ft), Albany hiring and tapeouts are corroborated by the grant agreement and the H2 spending guide. So this is not distress: roughly 2.5+ years of runway against a ~$875m market cap. The only negative is dilution at the current price.

findings.finding: Since the last print the company announced a dense run of non-revenue technical partnerships: ASML lithography (09-09), AMD Backline (09-10), a multi-million-dollar Bluefors cryogenics deal (09-29), a multi-year GlobalFoundries manufacturing partnership (10-06), and a HyperLight switch-loss cut from 20 to 7 mdB (11-10, the day before the print). The call can frame these as manufacturing de-risking.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose about 6% on the Bluefors deal plus RBC's initiation (2026-09-29), then kept falling. Partnership news has not held.
findings.why_not_priced: Each item was public and is largely priced. The HyperLight result came out the day before the print and no outlet besides company-feed aggregators has covered it. If it were priced, the tape would show a move on 11-10, and the 5-day run-up of +9.7% is explained by the peer rally.
findings.independence: HyperLight 7 mdB: https://www.stocktitan.net/overview/XNDU/ (single feed, same press release). GlobalFoundries: https://quantumcomputingreport.com/xanadu-partners-with-globalfoundries-to-scale-photonic-quantum-component-manufacturing-on-300-mm-semiconductor-lines. Bluefors: https://thequantuminsider.com/2026/09/29/xanadu-bluefors-cryogenic-infrastructure-utility-scale-quantum/.

findings.finding: Quantum peer tape: IonQ printed Q3 revenue of $173.8m (+336%) and raised FY2026 guidance to $505-515m. IonQ rose ~23% on 11-06 and ~9% on 11-09, and Rigetti and D-Wave rose 17% then 9% and 7% without news. XNDU's +9.7% over five days shows it joined the sector bid it reports into.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: XNDU has a beta of ~15 (MarketBeat via dailypolitical, 2026-11-05). Its sector moves dominate, but the stock fell through the summer quantum strength on its own supply overhang.
findings.why_not_priced: The sector bid is in XNDU's 5-day run-up, so this is partly priced. Rigetti's and D-Wave's 11-10 prints (not found) are the live read-through. This is a proxy: IonQ's revenue is not Xanadu's, and Xanadu just lost the DARPA stage IonQ won.
